action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix tenant isolation vulnerability in backend. The tenant filter is not being applied correctly when accessing employee resources across companies. When hr.multi@hris.id switches from KBS to NEP company context, they can still access/modify/delete KBS employee data. This affects GET, PUT, and DELETE operations on /api/employees/{id}. Verify tenant isolation is enforced in all CRUD operations across all resources (employees, contracts, certifications, documents, etc.). This is a CRITICAL SECURITY ISSUE that must be fixed before production use.
